_note: The scenario is the hidden definition of the world. The generator derives every record from it; nothing is hand-crafted. Rates and multipliers are strings so they parse as Decimal -- a float would be the one thing this project forbids everywhere else.
name: August Revenue Decline
description: A UPI technical-decline incident at three issuers, on top of a larger softening in attempt volume. The incident is real, localised, and NOT the primary revenue driver -- separating the two is the finding.
_quiet_band_note: No captures in the two days before a window. A capture just before a window -- especially after the cutoff -- settles inside that window's cycle and would read as an unmatched bank row (D-19).
_capture_counts_note: Capture counts are scenario DESIGN parameters. Everything downstream of them -- failures, values, fees, success rates, the decline -- is derived from the calibration layer and emerges. This is the line between 'we chose the shape of the story' and 'we chose the answer'.

incident._note: A technical-decline spike, not a mystery. TD is a back-end failure at a bank or at NPCI; BD is the customer's side and stays roughly flat. That separation is what lets the agent name a cause instead of a symptom.

demand._note: Attempt volume softens independently of the incident. Without it the whole decline would be attributable to the incident, and the bridge's rate/volume split would have nothing to separate.

settlement_policy._note: A commercial term, not a law (D-25). Overridable per scenario.

anomalies._note: Injected at fixed indices so the counts never drift. These are the only hand-placed records in the dataset.

fee_discrepancy._note: Applied as a WRONG INSTRUMENT RULE, not a random perturbation. The bank bills a zero-MDR UPI payment at the credit-card rate, and a credit-card payment at the debit rate. That is a real reconciliation finding with a named cause.

no_counterpart._note: Rs 840 / 620 / 380, totalling Rs 1,840. The original spec put these at Rs 18,400 against Rs 40L of monthly net revenue -- but Rs 40L over 341 payments implies a Rs 12,560 average ticket, roughly ten times a realistic Indian P2M ticket. With calibrated ticket sizes this merchant turns over about Rs 4L a month, so the unresolved value scales with it and stays a ~0.47% confidence band rather than a 4.7% one.

near_miss._note: Same amount, no reference, four business days past the SLA. Reachable only by rule 5 at 0.72, below the 0.85 auto-match threshold -- so it is a rejected candidate, not a match.

expected_diagnosis._note: What a correct investigation must conclude. Phase 11 scores against this, and verify-seed asserts it matches what the generator actually produced -- a ground truth that disagrees with its own dataset is worse than none.
expected_diagnosis.must_not_conclude: the technical-decline incident explains the revenue decline
expected_diagnosis._trap: The incident is the salient event in the window, and a model reasoning from narrative rather than arithmetic will name it as the cause. It is real, it is localised, and it is NOT the primary driver. Separating a genuine operational incident from the actual revenue driver is the finding.
